rv.q: Kimberley Walsh is a knockout in zestful production with an uncynical spirit.
It lacks genuine stardust, but it ticks enough boxes.
Big – the Musical just doesn't have the wow factor, and at times is plain boring.
Big The Musical, doesn't feel big, it feels hollow.
The score is largely forgettable, the cast are talented but the story is bland and surprisingly out of touch for the modern age.

cn.t: Mixed reviews greet this big-budget adaptation, with critics praising the charming leads' natural rapport but finding the production listless and lacking stardust, though its uncynical spirit delivers enough crowd-pleasing moments.
